jobs.occupation: Jet Engin Inspector | Zaventem | Permanent Contract
jobs.description:
Jet Engin Inspector wanted for a company in Zaventem. The company is a worldwide leader in design, development and production of aircraft engines. 

Your Responsibilities: Perform visual and dimensional inspections on dismantled parts in accordance with applicable procedures. Assess parts (serviceable, repairable, or scrap) using the ERP system and initiate necessary actions. Apply appropriate materials, tools, and methods. Ensure traceability by administratively closing completed tasks. 
Determine the future configuration of parts or modules. Conduct incoming inspections of repaired or purchased parts. 
Carry out final inspections after internal repairs.

 
• You have a superior technical secondary school degree (type A2 in Mechanics, Car Mechanics, Electromechanics...) with a strong foundation in mechanics and proven experience as an aeronautical technician, or a bachelor's degree in aviation with relevant experience in our field. 
 
• You have excellent knowledge of aircraft engines and proven experience as an Inspector. 
 
• You are stress-resistant and take responsibility 
 
• You are flexible can adapt to changing working conditions. 
 
• As an Inspector quality and safety are your priorities. 
 
• You are proactive and can take decisions in urgent situations. 
 
• You have a very good knowledge of technical English, with some knowledge of Dutch or French and you are willing to improve your skills. 
 
• You are willing to work 2 shifts (from 6am to 2pm, and from 2pm to 10pm). 
 
• You enjoy working in a team, in a multilingual environment and supporting your colleagues.Requirements: 
Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium (EU passport or valid work and residence permit). 
Visa or permit assistance is not provided.

jobs.occupation: Internal Sales Coördinator | Brecht | Vast Contract
jobs.description:
Internal Sales Coördinator 

Are you an experienced people manager who enjoys bringing structure to a fast-paced operational environment? Do you combine strong leadership skills with a hands-on approach to order management, backlog management and customer service?

For an international and dynamic organization, I am looking for an Internal Sales Coördinator to lead a team of four employees.
In this role, you will be close to both the people and the operation. You will coach and develop your team, set priorities, monitor performance and ensure that customers and internal stakeholders receive clear and timely follow-up.

Your responsibilities 

 
• Lead, organize, motivate and coach a team of 4 employees on a daily basis. 
 
• Oversee order and backlog management and ensure customer service enquiries are handled efficiently. 
 
• Set priorities and distribute the workload evenly across the team. 
 
• Monitor team performance, operational metrics and KPIs, and take action where needed. 
 
• Identify training and development needs and provide ongoing coaching. 
 
• Conduct regular one-to-one meetings and performance evaluations. 
 
• Listen to team members' feedback and support them in resolving challenges or conflicts. 
 
• Create sufficient space for team members to contribute to improvement projects alongside their daily responsibilities. 
 
• Work closely with internal stakeholders to resolve escalations and ensure clear communication regarding priorities, progress and expected deliverables. 
 
• Provide management with feedback on operational challenges and identify opportunities for continuous improvement. 
 
• Contribute to a positive and collaborative working environment and organize team-building activities. 

Who are we looking for?
For this position, I am looking for someone who knows how to lead and develop people while maintaining a strong overview of the operational priorities. 

 
• You have several years of experience in a leadership or coordinating position, ideally within sales operations, order management or customer service. 
 
• You have proven people management experience and enjoy coaching, motivating and developing team members. 
 
• You have experience with backlog management and are strong at setting priorities and maintaining overview. 
 
• You are an excellent coordinator and communicator who can effectively manage expectations with different stakeholders. 
 
• You are comfortable monitoring KPIs and using them to drive team performance. 
 
• You have strong organizational, analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 
• You remain calm and effective in a dynamic environment and know how to manage competing priorities. 
 
• You are comfortable working both independently and collaboratively. 
 
• You have solid computer skills, including experience with Microsoft Office, CRM systems and SAP. 
 
• You are fluent in English. Additional languages are an asset, but not a requirement. 
 
• Experience with data modelling and data management tools is considered an advantage.

You will join a large logistics company in Puurs. The work environment is friendly and respectful, with a strong focus on safety and personal development. You get the chance to take initiative and grow within a stable organization.

.

What you will do
 
 

• Operate and monitor high-tech automated machines to ensure uninterrupted production. 

• Maintain accurate performance and efficiency of the tools as qualified user. 

• Follow and understand procedures, instructions and WoW quickly and apply them correctly. 

• Able to act correctly and clearly under pressure and ask support when needed.  

• Quickly identify and report any issues or malfunctions to First Line Support (FLS) or WIP lead. 

• Follow safety and operational procedures to maintain a secure and efficient work environment. 

• Communicate in clear language and understandable terms (also in English) and participate actively in shift handover.  

• Keep everything tidy according to 5S rules. 

• Refill chemicals. 

Who you are
 
 

• Experience in operations environment or a similar field is preferred, but we focus on potential. 

• Strong organizational and multitasking skills. 

• Ability to work independently and prioritize tasks effectively. 

• Good communication and teamwork skills. 

• Proactive, detail-oriented and dynamic. 

• Knowledge of English  

Below is an example of the shift schedule, providing a clear understanding of the work hours and rotation you can expect in this role:
 
 

• Week X: You will work the early shift (06:15 – 14:15) from Monday to Friday. 

• Week X+1: You work the night shift (21:45 – 06:30) from Monday to Friday. 

• Week X+2: You work the late shift (14:00 – 22:00) from Monday to Wednesday, on Thursday and Friday you have recuperation and on Saturday and Sunday you work 12h - (06:30 – 18:30)  

• Week X+3: From Monday to Wednesday, you have recuperation and on Thursday and Friday you work in the late shift (14:00 – 22:00). 

• Week X: You work from Monday to Friday in the early shift. (06:15 – 14:15).

We guarantee that you won’t be bored
 

As a process operator, you have several responsibilities: 
 
 

• You will receive an intensive training before coordinating and operating high-end devices in the clean room. 

• You organize your own workload according to defined goals. 

• You are responsible for the quality of your own processing. 

• You perform quality tests meticulously. 

• You accurately report problems to our engineers.  

• You have a keen eye for safety and operational efficiency. 

• You suggest improvements.  

Who are we looking for?
 

Well, an enthusiastic personality and a passion for technology already go a long way. You are hands-on, full of expectation and eager to prove yourself. You enjoy working in a team, are accurate, dare to take initiative and are not afraid of asking questions. You have fluent communication skills in English. You are not looking for a typical nine-to-five and you see the advantages of working in shifts every now and again — handsome bonusses and lots of quality time on your hands while others are ‘insanely busy’. An example of our shift regime:
 
 

• Week X: You will work the early shift from Monday to Friday. 

• Week X+1: You work the night shift from Monday to Friday. 

• Week X+2: You work the late shift from Monday to Wednesday, on Thursday and Friday you have recuperation and on Saturday and Sunday you work 12h. 

• Week X+3: From Monday to Wednesday you have recuperation and on Thursday and Friday you work in the late shift. 

• Week X: You work from Monday to Friday in the early shift.

Comecer is expanding its international Service Team! To strengthen our team in Belgium, we are looking for 
Field Service Engineers, preferably based in the 
Brussels–Leuven region. You will be employed by Orise NV 
(former Process Automation Solutions), based in Belgium, and part of ATS Corporation, while working closely with Comecer Netherlands BV and the wider Comecer team.
 

In this role, you will help install, maintain and support high-tech systems that play a critical role in the (radio)pharmaceutical and nuclear medicine sectors.
 

Comecer’s solutions are developed and manufactured in Joure (The Netherlands) and are used in complex laboratory environments worldwide.
 

 
 

What you will do
 

In this role, you will be 
responsible for installing, servicing, and maintaining Comecer equipment at customer sites throughout Belgium. You will carry out both preventive and corrective maintenance, ensuring that each system performs optimally and meets all operational requirements. In addition, you will provide 
training and technical support to end users, helping them understand and operate the equipment effectively. Throughout every assignment, you will communicate clearly and professionally with customers and internal teams, representing Comecer as a trusted, solution-oriented technical expert.

What you bring
 

You bring hands‑on experience in repairing technical equipment and troubleshooting both mechanical and electrical issues. You are able to read and interpret electrical, pneumatic and mechanical drawings, and you have a background in electronics, electromechanics or mechanical engineering. In this role, strong communication skills and a customer‑focused attitude are essential, along with a willingness to travel within Belgium and occasionally abroad. You have an energetic, proactive and solution‑driven mindset.
 

Requirements:
 
 

• Technical degree at secondary or bachelor level (electromechanics, electronics or mechatronics). 

• Strong English and French skills; Dutch is an advantage. 

• Experience with PLC-controlled systems is considered as a plus. 

• Valid category B driving licence.
